title: Underground infrastructure at the Nevada Test Site for craft and retrieval teams

tellings.quote: the underground infrastructure is there to to house Alfred O'Donnell's craft

plain: Underground facilities at the Nevada Test Site, the government's old nuclear testing ground, are said to exist to house craft linked to a man named Alfred O'Donnell, along with teams that retrieve such craft. An online researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb lays out this theory on Michels' show, without a named source, tying it to the story of Bob Lazar, a man who has claimed he worked on alien craft in Nevada. If true, it would put a hidden home for recovered craft beneath the test site.
